title: converge-slim-retries-and-explicit-stream-close-across-py-ts-go
author: Maya Singh
description: Context: We have three SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) drifting in ergonomics for retry presets and streaming lifecycle: consumers have inconsistent default backoff windows, token refresh races subtly leak stale bearer tokens during resume, and stream consumers have no canonical close/handoff semantics which makes deterministic cleanup tricky for upstream frameworks. Motivation: small, cross-language ergonomics wins reduce support burden and make tri-sdk examples portable. This PR introduces a compact, documented 'slim' retry presets bundle, a lightweight explicit stream-close API surfaced consistently across languages, and a defensive auth handshake change to avoid a token-swap race during stream resume. Summary of changes: 1) Add retry_presets.slim (spec) and implement bindings for py/ts/go. The presets provide three profiles (fast, balanced, conservative) with deterministic jitter math consistent across runtimes. 2) Introduce StreamHandle.close()/asyncClose() and CloseStream(ctx) to ensure the SDK flushes KV cache cursors and emits a final telemetry event; this is exposed as a simple sync/async method in each SDK. 3) Fix token-swap race: introduce a short-lived token window (50ms) while resuming streams and ensure outgoing requests observe the latest token via atomic swap. 4) Make small public API surface changes: add retry_policy=RetryPresets.SLIM on client constructors and a StreamOptions.auto_close boolean defaulting to false to avoid behavioral change for current users. 5) Add end-to-end tests for resume + token refresh, stream close idempotency, and cross-language parity asserts in the monorepo harness. 6) Bump versions: python -> 1.12.0, typescript -> 1.8.0, go -> 1.5.2. Migration notes: existing users are unaffected by default; to opt into the new presets pass retry_policy=RetryPresets.SLIM (or equivalent). If you rely on implicit stream finalization via GC, opt-in to StreamOptions.auto_close=true to enable explicit close hooks. Checklist: - [x] API design review with SDK leads - [x] Unit tests for each SDK - [x] E2E parity tests in harness - [x] Documentation snippets for migration - [x] Telemetry event added for stream.close - [x] Version bumps and changelogs updated Files of note changed: see changed_files list below. CI: first run failed due to a flaky ts test (race in mock timer), fixed by introducing deterministic fake timers in ts harness. All checks green on final run. Merge: squash-merged to main with canonical commit message below. Related: ENG-2048 (retry profile consolidation), ENG-2101 (stream lifecycle hygiene).

release_notes: Added SLIM retry presets (fast/balanced/conservative) exposed via RetryPresets.SLIM for tri-SDKs. Introduced explicit StreamHandle.close()/asyncClose() across SDKs and an opt-in StreamOptions.auto_close flag. Fixed token-swap race on stream resume with a configurable resume_token_window (default 50ms). Added e2e parity tests and bumped SDK versions: python 1.12.0, typescript 1.8.0, go 1.5.2.
notes_for_support: If customers report differing retry behavior after bump, confirm whether they are using RetryPresets.SLIM or legacy defaults.
To debug token resume issues enable SDK debug logs (RETRY and STREAM categories) which now include resume_token_window and token-swap markers.
Auto-close is opt-in; recommend conservative migration: flip StreamOptions.auto_close when you can verify final telemetry events in staging.
